lq.ANSWER: Society is the next larger order after family. It is made up of many families living together and making collective effort for a common goal. Harmony in society means that human beings live together in a way that fulfils the human goal. The human goal includes right understanding and right feeling in every individual, prosperity in every family, fearlessness or trust in society, and co-existence with nature. For this, society requires proper systems such as education-sanskar, health-sanyam, production-work, justice-suraksha and exchange-storage. When these systems are guided by right understanding, they support mutual happiness and mutual prosperity. Thus, a harmonious society is not just a crowd of people; it is a family-based society where individuals and families participate responsibly for the fulfilment of the human goal.
lq.QUESTION_DESC: Explain the meaning of harmony in society.
